problem.title: Delivery Promo Code
problem.statement: Find the longest prefix of a food delivery promo code that matches the prefix of a user's loyalty string.
problem.description: On the QuickBite food delivery app, users can apply promo codes to get discounts. A promo code system validates codes by comparing them against the user's loyalty string. Given two strings representing a promo code and a user loyalty string, determine the length of the longest common prefix starting from the beginning of both strings.
problem.inputFormat: The input consists of two lines. The first line contains the promo code string S1. The second line contains the user loyalty string S2.
problem.outputFormat: Print a single integer representing the length of the longest common prefix between S1 and S2.
constraints: S1 and S2 consist of uppercase English letters only
problem.sampleExplanation: The promo code is 'DISCOUNT50' and the loyalty string is 'DISC_USER'. The characters at the beginning match for 'D', 'I', 'S', and 'C' (4 characters). The fifth character 'O' does not match '_'. Thus, the length of the longest common prefix is 4.
problem.timeComplexity: O(min(N, M)) where N and M are the lengths of the strings
problem.spaceComplexity: O(N + M) to store the input strings

bruteForce.approach: Iterate through both strings character by character simultaneously to count matching characters from the beginning until a mismatch is found.
